# single-request runner cannot express. Issue #259 covers them in
# `tests/extract_index.rs` — the index response is matched there against

# same sentence that separately names "the corrupt-PDF 500 envelope" — read
# together, "seven" means the seven extractOnly=true SUCCESS captures, with
# extract_corrupt_pdf as an eighth, distinct case. This file includes
# extract_corrupt_pdf as an eighth row anyway: the differential harness
# is the one place that actually re-proves the 500 envelope end-to-end
# through the real multipart route (the fixture-derived unit tests only
# assert it once), and the TSV format already carries a non-200 `status`
# column for exactly this shape (see `manifest-errors.tsv`). Excluding it
# would leave the harness with no live-mode coverage of the one response this
# issue is riskiest on. Flagged for the implementor/reviewer rather than
# Captured against solr:9.10.1 (see solr-ref/capture.sh's #261 block). The
